observations: The 4B and 9B candidates both saturated the 12-interaction schema on the courtyard case.
Saturated responses repeated or invented interactions and used up to 1636 output tokens.
No successful call approached the 300-second timeout.
The retained contract keeps room above the two expected case interactions while bounding edit cost.
After adding source-interaction identity, 4B returned exactly the two expected interactions on both cases without repetition or limit saturation.
All 4B geometry was valid after deterministic coordinate clamping.
9B matched 4B on structured reliability and post-clamp validity but did not improve destination-token resolution.
35B had cleaner raw geometry, but did not improve destination-token resolution and is substantially larger.
In the end-to-end generated-image case, 4B invented two interactions and reached the four-interaction limit; 9B and 35B returned the two authored actions.
The end-to-end 35B polygons were tighter, but 9B remained valid and editable at a smaller model size.

model_recommendation: Use qwen3.5:9b as the smallest candidate with reliable end-to-end interaction counts and editable geometry under the selected contract. Keep destination choices author-reviewable because all candidates returned supplied destinations unresolved in this evaluation.
